name: smwsprites-score
title: Score
description:
A disassembly of all the vanilla score sprites for use with PIXI 1.40+.
There are four files in this submission's downloadable file:
score.asm, which behaves like regular score sprites,
lifeup.asm, which behaves like 1-UP score sprites,
coins.asm, which behaves like the unused/glitched coin score sprites,
and all.asm, which is a disassembly of all score sprites in a single file. it's impractical for use with PIXI, but it's been included because it's a disassembly of the original code.
